article.title: Purdue and Washington meet in Big Ten play
article.linkText: Purdue and Washington meet in Big Ten play
article.story: Washington (3-3) at Purdue (3-3), Oct. 16 at 8 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Purdue by 3. Against the spread: Purdue 3-2-1, Washington 1-5. How to watch: FOX Key stats Purdue Offense Overall: 415.5 yards per game (53rd in FBS) Passing: 282 yards per game (19th) Rushing: 133.5 yards per game (104th) Scoring: 32.2 points per game (55th) Purdue Defense Overall: 400.7 yards per game (114th in FBS) Passing: 243.2 yards per game (113th) Rushing: 157.5 yards per game (93rd) Scoring: 31.3 points per game (119th) Washington Offense Overall: 369.8 yards per game (90th in FBS) Passing: 279.5 yards per game (22nd) Rushing: 90.3 yards per game (135th) Scoring: 26.2 points per game (88th) Washington Defense Overall: 330.3 yards per game (48th in FBS) Passing: 193.7 yards per game (49th) Rushing: 136.7 yards per game (59th) Scoring: 22.2 points per game (60th) Washington ranks 121st in third down percentage, converting 31.3% of the time. Washington is 15th in the FBS with a +5 turnover margin. Washington ranks 121st in the FBS averaging 73.2 penalty yards per game, compared to Purdue's 59th-ranked 54.5 per-game average. Washington is 102nd in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 90% of trips. Purdue's red zone offense ranks 24th, scoring on 93.3% of red zone opportunities. Washington ranks 91st in the FBS with an average time of possession of 29:08, compared to Purdue's 22nd-ranked average of 32:53. Team leaders Purdue Passing: Ryan Browne, 1,549 yards, 9 TDs, 1 INT, 68.9 completion percentage Rushing: Fame Ijeboi, 549 yards on 117 carries, 9 TDs Receiving: Asaad Waseem, 472 yards on 29 catches, 1 TD Washington Passing: Demond Williams Jr., 1,396 yards, 8 TDs, 3 INTs, 66.7 completion percentage Rushing: Brian Bonner Jr., 232 yards on 51 carries, 0 TDs Receiving: Dezmen Roebuck, 387 yards on 43 catches, 2 TDs Last game Purdue defeated Minnesota 41-13 on Oct. 10. Browne passed for 159 yards on 14-of-24 attempts (58.3%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for 81 yards and one rushing touchdown. Ijeboi carried the ball 31 times for 195 yards and scored three touchdowns, adding two receptions for -4 yards. De'Nylon Morrissette had two receptions for 51 yards. Washington fell to Iowa 41-24 on Oct. 9. Elijah Brown passed for 251 yards on 28-of-39 attempts (71.8%) with three touchdowns and no interceptions. Bonner carried the ball 10 times for 17 yards. Chris Lawson had eight receptions for 86 yards and one touchdown. Next game Purdue plays at Penn State on Oct. 31. Washington plays at Nebraska on Oct. 31.
